title: AT 17, HE WENT TO WAR... HIS HOMECOMING TOOK 74 YEARS
description: In 1950, 17-year-old Albert J. Estrada left Woodland, California, to answer his country's call during the Korean War. Barely old enough to be considered an adult, he put on the uniform of the United States Army and joined thousands of young Americans willing to risk everything for a cause greater than themselves.

title: The Sound of the American Heart: Ranking the Top 10 Greatest Country Songs of All Time
description: Country music is more than just a musical genre—it is the storytelling soul of American culture. Built on honest lyrics, acoustic strings, heartbreak, and blue-collar resilience, country songs capture the triumphs and heartaches of everyday life like nothing else.  While thousands of classics have graced the airwaves over the decades, a select few stand as timeless monumental masterpieces. Here is a definitive ranking of the Top 10 Greatest Country Songs of All Time.

title: THEY ENTERED THE VALLEY AS SOLDIERS... HE LEFT IT A HERO
description: Today, we salute the legacy of U.S. Army Sergeant Reginald Alvin Watkins—a young leader whose courage, sacrifice, and unwavering devotion to his fellow soldiers became part of one of the most defining battles of the Vietnam War.

title: Two seconds. That is all it took to make the ultimate decision
description: Most people spend a lifetime wondering what they would do in a split-second crisis. But when fate called, this United States Marine didn't hesitate. In the final two seconds of his life, faced with unimaginable danger, his instinct wasn't self-preservation—it was protecting the brothers standing beside him.

title: He Never Made It to His 20th Birthday… But He Earned a Place in History.
description: Born on December 27, 1990, in San Jose, California, Arden was known for his warm smile, kind heart, and unwavering loyalty to the people he loved. He enjoyed music, cars, video games, and spending time with his younger brothers. But beneath his easygoing personality was a young man with an unshakable desire to serve something greater than himself. Soon after graduating from high school, he answered America's call and earned the title of United States Marine.
